title: Paul Lee
description: "I envisioned the future Leia as the most powerful Jedi Knight ever," observes Paul Lee. "Although her Force has yet to be developed, she too has the blood of a Skywalker. In her hand she carries the mask of Vader...a symbol of her heritage and her power." Lee, a graduate of Art Center College of Design, worked on the now infamous TRUE CRIME trading card sets. His paintings have been featured in PLAYBOY, OMNI, L.A. WEEKLY and can also be seen at the Sarah Bain Gallery in Brea, California.
